verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say its PR review scans every pull request for logic errors, style inconsistencies, and potential security vulnerabilities, so security findings sit alongside functional bugs. Ultrareview is positioned for security-sensitive changes, and codebase scans also hunt for vulnerabilities. missing for 10: explicit documentation of specific security classes (injection, leaked secrets, insecure patterns), any independent or hands-on corroboration of security-finding accuracy.
